'''Explorer's Crag''' was a steep peak located in the vicinity of the [[Happy Grove/Legends|Happy Grove]] on the [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. At some point in history, a [[Unidentified traveling explorer|traveling explorer]] visited the skies of Endor in a [[hot air balloon]], but crashed on top of the Explorer's Crag. That individual was unable to get down from the peak, and subsequently [[Death/Legends|died]] in the balloon's basket. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], the native Ewoks found the ballon and the remains of the explorer when the young [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] flew over the Explorer's Crag with his [[Hang-glider/Legends|skin glider]].<ref name="TB" />
